description: The most relevant number of the problem "citizen participation" of the start page ranking and the potential solutions. A referendum reduces a multifaceted issue to one binary yes or no decision, so the number of positions a voter can express is the size of the problem. The solutions are a solidarity compass for initiatives and the argument level voting of fluid democracy.

triples.name: citizen participation
triples.description: the missing overview of the solidarity effects of an initiative, which reduces a multifaceted issue to a binary yes or no decision (concept paper section 10)

triples.name: fluid democracy
triples.description: a structured, argument based and iterative process in which every citizen can propose, debate and decide binding rules (concept paper section 10)

triples.name: solidarity compass
triples.description: a voting advice application for initiatives that shows who benefits, who bears the costs and which trade-offs are involved (concept paper section 10)

sources.name: Walder, Fivaz & Schwarz (2026)
sources.description: Walder, M., Fivaz, J. & Schwarz, D. (2026): Voting Advice Applications and Their Impact on Ideological and Affective Polarization. Politics and Governance, 14.

sources.name: Referendum (Wikipedia)
sources.description: A referendum is a direct vote in which the electorate accepts or rejects one proposal, so a voter can express exactly two positions on it.
